name: Provide Assistance to Farmers Bringing Goods to Market Committees for Cost of Goods Transportation (Tribal)
benefit: **Financial Assistance:** ₹500/- per tonne of agricultural produce transported. Assistance is available for up to 10 tonnes per farmer, which amounts to a maximum of ₹5,000/-.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a tribal farmer. 1. The applicant should be residing in a tribal area of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should bring their agricultural produce to a registered market committee (APMC) located in the tribal area. 1. The applicant should be the owner or cultivator of the agricultural goods transported.
